name: Boulderfist Hall
summary: Boulderfist ogres hold the southern hills of the Arathi Highlands, north of Thandol Span. Under Kor'gresh Coldrage, they threaten the nearby roads and valleys.

sections.title: A Bastion of Brute Strength
sections.body: Boulderfist Hall shelters the Boulderfist clan in the southern bluffs of the Arathi Highlands. Its earthen walls and deep caverns house ogre brutes and magi, near Witherbark Village and the bridge at Thandol Span. Kor'gresh Coldrage leads the clan from deep within the mound, with enforcers such as Phalanax at his side. The ogres hold the surrounding roads by force, making travel between Arathi and the Wetlands dangerous for travelers and supply caravans.

faq.answer: Boulderfist Hall is a fortified mound and cave complex in the southern Arathi Highlands. The Boulderfist clan makes its base there.
Kor'gresh Coldrage leads the ogres from a deep cavern in the mound. Champions such as Phalanax stand beside him.

faq.q: Why is this location strategically important?
faq.answer: Close to Thandol Span, the Boulderfist ogres can threaten the overland route between the Arathi Highlands and Khaz Modan. They prey on travelers and choke off traffic.

faq.q: Are the Boulderfist allied with the nearby Witherbark trolls?
faq.answer: No formal alliance binds the Boulderfist ogres and the Witherbark forest trolls. They live near one another at Witherbark Village, and at Boulder'gor elsewhere in the highlands, Witherbark trolls share ground with ogres. Both groups remain hostile to outsiders of every faction.

angles.text: Above Thandol Span, Boulderfist ogres threaten Alliance couriers and reinforcements traveling north from Ironforge into Arathi.
To secure the Arathi Highlands, you must break the ogres' independent power and clear the southern ridge. That protects Horde movement from Hammerfall.
